verdict.rationale: Stable's marketing pages say it can forward mail and packages anywhere in the world at discounted rates, so self-serve physical forwarding exists in some form. The 'auto-route' claim covers routing mail to internal teams, not rule-based physical forwarding. The API docs list only MailItem search and retrieval plus Location creation, with no forwarding endpoint. Missing for 10: rule-based or one-click forwarding, saved recipients, carrier choice, cost shown before confirming, any docs or hands-on proof of the forwarding workflow.
